verdict.rationale: Multi-currency billing is a fair question for a usage-based billing platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions local-currency invoicing, per-currency price points, FX conversion, or consolidated home-currency reporting. The generic data-export, revenue-recognition and Stripe-invoicing items do not address currency, and adjacent features earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency
